text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp had begun once again.
Satono Diamond threw herself wholeheartedly into the rigorous regimen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Phew! My time improved again.
I don't feel too exhausted either, so perhaps my stamina is building up?

In that case, increasing her endurance training would be ideal.
I decided to consult her on the next exercise.
choice_data_list: What sounds better next: a marathon or open-water swimming?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's see, it is quite hot today, so swim—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
Which one do you believe would be better, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood.

Just as I thought... Satono Diamond had been acting a bit distant
ever since our day at the amusement park...

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaat!? There's a festival tonight?
I wanna go, I wanna go! Let's all go together~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A festival...? Oh, that sounds so lovely!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! Um, that is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...! Are you sure that's alright?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Wow! It is so lively here.
There are so many fascinating food stalls!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what might that be? It doesn't look like goldfish scooping...
There are lots of sparkling things floating in the water.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!
All the sparkling bouncy balls you can scoop~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, do I scoop them with this bowl?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A poi...?
Ah, so the rule is to scoop them using that round frame!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Without tearing such delicate paper...
I wonder what that feels like? Hmmm...?
choice_data_list: Let me show you how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you don't have to go out of your way—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow...!
Incredible! You caught a big one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
...You seem unusually fired up, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It makes me happy when you rely on me.
It makes me happy when you rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Happy...? It makes you happy when I rely on you?
I'm not being... a burden...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! Um, I... I—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Is it really okay for me to just be honest with you...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I mean, even if I tell you how I truly feel...
It won't... trouble you...?

It seems she had been holding herself back out of concern...
But there was no need for that. Because—
choice_data_list: Your honesty is one of your greatest strengths.
Your honesty is one of your greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A strength...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I see... That's how you felt all along...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (That's right... Even back then, you—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please be honest with me.
If things stay as they are, what will happen?
"To be honest... I don't think you stand a chance like this."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I confront you head-on, you always respond with total sincerity...
And thanks to that, we are where we are today.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It seems I had lost sight of something truly important.

Away from the hustle and bustle, with just the two of us,
Satono Diamond opened up, bit by bit...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have a habit of immediately saying and doing whatever comes to mind, don't I?
I started overthinking, worried that I was bothering you...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So I tried to suppress it and hold back.
Even the other day...
choice_data_list: When we went to the amusement park?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The truth is, I was so thrilled about that prize, I almost blurted out
"I want us to have matching ones!" and "I'll win one too!"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But the thought crossed my mind that maybe you didn't want one,
and suddenly, I couldn't say a single word.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I really should have just been honest with you, shouldn't I?
choice_data_list: We can always go out together again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! It's a promise, then.
I'll make sure to think of places I want to visit!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You'd better brace yourself, okay? Now that you've told me
"honesty is a strength"... I won't hold back anymore!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how outrageous the destination, or how many things I ask for,
you'll take it all in stride... won't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu! How wonderfully reassuring...
Oh—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes... Truly breathtaking...!

Fireworks continue to light up the distant night sky.
If we head back toward the festival grounds, we could probably get a closer look.
choice_data_list: Let's head back and watch from up close!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please... no.

Catching up at a light jog, Satono Diamond
tugged at the hem of my shirt from behind.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to watch them just like this... with only the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So please, let's not go back.
I want to stay right here with you just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... This is Dia's honest feelings right now!
That's okay, isn't it? Trainer.

Guided by her gentle pull, we sat side by side on the sandy beach,
gazing out at the small fireworks blooming far in the distance—
